title: Connectivity runbook 1
text: VPN disconnects while connected to office wifi
steps: Reconnect the VPN after updating the client and checking the gateway health.

title: Reporting runbook 1
text: Sales dashboard access denied after release v2.3
steps: Restore the reporting application role mapping introduced in v2.3; verify dashboard access.

title: Endpoint runbook 1
text: Suspicious attachment opened and endpoint malware alert
steps: Isolate the endpoint and ask Security to investigate the attachment and endpoint alert.

title: Devices runbook 1
text: Laptop screen flickering with display artifacts
steps: Test an external display, update the approved display driver, then arrange panel replacement if needed.

title: Identity runbook 1
text: Account locked and MFA recovery code rejected
steps: Verify identity using the approved recovery process, unlock the account, and re-enroll MFA.

title: Messaging runbook 1
text: Outlook mailbox not receiving messages quota full
steps: Check mailbox quota, archive approved messages, and verify incoming mail delivery.

title: Payroll runbook 1
text: Payroll portal login fails after employee record transfer
steps: Synchronize the employee payroll record and restore the payroll portal entitlement.

title: Printing runbook 1
text: Printer not working on third floor paper jam
steps: Clear the paper path using the device guide and ask Facilities to service the feed roller.

title: Reporting runbook 1
text: Reporting export hangs and sales report is blank
steps: Restart the reporting export worker and retry the job after confirming queue health.

title: Connectivity runbook 1
text: Conference room wifi drops packets during meetings
steps: Check the access point health and move affected clients to the healthy office network.
